about: r86 v4.8 hunt: 60 everyday lines on the round-11 page jurors' engine items. 30 announcement frames in the one grammar (subject or none, any run of intensifiers including doubled and comma-joined ones, one feeling or two, finally/officially/now, a clause or a named thing after the verb, mid-line after a comma, lowercase, emoji, @handles, a funding round, hard news) and 30 topic intros (why/how/whether/what after a run-up, in a frame or a label, story frames and "Can we talk about how" that stay claims, an exclamative how, a link, a thread pointer, two sentences). Written by the engine pass, never tuned on before this pass; graded in READY14.
